summary.text: Dotie Joseph represents District 108 in the Florida House of Representatives as a Democrat, elected in 2018 and reelected subsequently, and was Minority Leader pro tempore from 2022 to 2024.

paragraphs.text: Joseph is an attorney who lives in North Miami. Joseph was born in Haiti and moved to Florida in 1982.
Joseph holds a B.A. from Yale College (2001) and a J.D. from Georgetown University Law Center (2005).
